_help: Refurbished machines you source yourself. Add one block per machine, then commit; it appears in the shop at the next update. price = what the client pays, including GST (your cost incl. GST and delivery x 1.25, rounded up to $5). Don't put your buy price here: this file is public. Set "sold": true (or delete the block) when it's gone. Photos: put a file in photos/ named after the part (e.g. photos/LAT7310-01.jpg) or paste an image link in "image". Never put the seller's name here; this file is public. For items you source on request (price and stock confirmed when a client asks), add "onRequest": true and an optional "priceTo" for a price range; clients see "From $X" and a "Request this item" button instead of Add to cart. Optional: "specialUntil" (date and time, e.g. 2026-11-20T22:59:00+11:00) and "specialLabel" for limited-time prices; after that time the item automatically shows "Price and stock on request" instead of a price. "src" is a private one-letter supplier code shown only in your order texts.
